metadata.title: Research data supporting "A multi-agent system for RNA design with capability-gated prediction and constraint-navigated generation"
metadata.description: Benchmark and anchor assets for the RNADesignAgent manuscript: the RNADesign-210 benchmark suite plus four further registered benchmark suites (the 31-session process-aware regression suite, the 20-target full-length mRNA suite with its five-target deployment cohort register, the 20-target aptamer suite with its six-target deployment cohort, and the 39-target expanded aptamer pool); the two derived claim-audit task sets (45 aptamer tasks, 20 full-length mRNA tasks); the assertion-curated external anchor sets used for capability profiling and biological-validity controls (wild-type CDS collection with 200 seeded random synonymous controls, aptamer binder/negative panels with measured affinities, measured-MRL 5'UTR anchor families, IRES literature panel, small-molecule binder/non-binder pairs, vaccine-mRNA assemblies, mRNA-stability panel); the packaged capability SelfModel with its generator; and the per-experiment model-usage register. A per-file SHA-256 manifest is included. Frozen per-campaign evidence records remain in the project repository (code availability statement). v3.0 adds the frozen records of the external-baseline comparison (Results, Fig. 6): the bare-model and same-tool ReAct campaign records (per-turn runs, deterministic adjudications, summaries) and the three-arm comparison output (delivery tables, failure-mode decomposition, paired tests, claim adjudication, cost ledger); the platform condition reuses its frozen production records.
